decisions.decision: What R5 is.
decisions.ruling: The brainstorm amendment of 2026-11-15 to the split record (B1-B13): bundles stay as the optional pick unit; tool packs become tool knowledge keyed by bootstrap tool; knowledge packs slim down; templates stay; no vwf.yaml format 29.
decisions.rejected: Packs and bundles go, the generator writes every stack per repo (the first R5 interview, stopped by the user).

decisions.decision: How R5 splits.
decisions.ruling: Two plans: R5a (this folder) is stackgen and the repo tooling; R5b is vwf and requires R5a. No release between them.

decisions.decision: The bundle frontmatter.
decisions.ruling: tools: bootstrap tool names, no version; packs: <type>/<slug>@<version> knowledge packs. Tool knowledge is not listed: it follows the tools. name, axis, kind, default, platforms and artifact stay.

decisions.decision: How tool knowledge is keyed.
decisions.ruling: 18 entries under plugins/stackgen/tools/<slug>/, each with tool.yaml naming its bootstrap tools (the table of 01-tree.md part A); bash and markdown name none and apply to every repo.

decisions.decision: A user who picks no shipped bundle.
decisions.ruling: A repo bundle at .claude/stackgen/bundles/<slug>.md, written by a new compose verb of stackgen-stack-menu that architecture (R5b) calls; an uncovered item is the ref <kind>/<slug>@generated. A bundle is never mandatory.
decisions.rejected: Free pick with no bundle; the repo bundle written at setup.

decisions.decision: The design adapters.
decisions.ruling: plugins/stackgen/design-tools/ holds three generic role skills at the fixed names and one folder per tool (tool.yaml, conventions.md, references/<role>.md, skills/ for a tool-only skill such as design-session). Materialize adds the role skills once and a named tool's references and skills to vwf-tools. The menu's design axis lists the tool folders. The design-tool kind and its bundles go.
decisions.rejected: Prefix the skills per tool; keep design-tool packs; materialize into the repo.

decisions.decision: The addon.
decisions.ruling: An addon is a Claude plugin that bootstrap installs (R5b runs bootstrap add plugin). plugins/stackgen/assets/addons.yaml lists them; the menu reads it. The addon kind, its pack and its bundle go.
decisions.rejected: The bootstrap catalog as the list; drop addons.

decisions.decision: The pack test task files (android test/e2e, compose and swiftui test/golden).
decisions.ruling: They are static scripts; bootstrap ships them as tool parts in a new plan, R2e (android e2e; the kotlin or android golden with a tool question on the library; swift golden). R5a deletes them from the packs. p/_project/deploy and p/_project/icons stay in the packs.

decisions.decision: Where the LSP entries come from.
decisions.ruling: vwf-tools takes lspServers from data.servers of bootstrap lsp --json, unchanged (bootstrap R2b D4). The packs lose lsp_servers; the generator researches no LSP server.

decisions.decision: How tool knowledge reaches a repo.
decisions.ruling: Materialize copies each entry whose tools meet a tool the project links or the bundle names, and every entry with tools: [], into .claude/skills/; lock.yaml records tool/<slug>@<version>.

decisions.decision: Repos materialized before R5a.
decisions.ruling: stackgen-sync converts once: tool-pack rows become tool/<slug>@1.0.0 rows with the files kept; design-tool rows are removed and the tool goes into vwf-tools; addon rows and rows of the deleted test task files are removed, the files left in place; a report lists each change.

decisions.decision: The checker and the inventory.
decisions.ruling: Keep every rule: 4 adds tools/ and design-tools/ skills; 8 checks design-tools/; 9 unchanged; 11 forbids test/ tasks in a pack config/ and config/ in a tool entry, and retires the moved keys; 13 scans tools/ and design-tools/; 14 checks bundle tools against the snapshot and pack refs against stacks/. The inventory adds tool entries and design tools.
decisions.rejected: Retire rules 11, 13 and 14 and the inventory (the first R5 interview).

decisions.decision: How the checker knows bootstrap's tool names.
decisions.ruling: scripts/src/bootstrap-tools.ts writes a committed snapshot, scripts/src/bootstrap-tools.json, from bootstrap catalog --json (every supported tool, not only installed ones); --check fails when stale; rule 14 reads the file. The mise task and its pre-commit hook are a hand step in this repo's .config/.
decisions.rejected: A fixed list by hand; a live bootstrap call in every check and in CI.

decisions.decision: Pack and bundle versions.
decisions.ruling: Each changed knowledge pack bumps MAJOR (13 and 17 skipped); bundle refs follow; tool entries and design tools start at 1.0.0. U5 bumps, after the edits.

decisions.decision: ux-gate and the docs/blueprint/ references in the typescript pack.
decisions.ruling: They stay in tools/typescript/ in R5a; R5b moves them to vwf with the UX reviewer change. R5a edits no vwf file.

decisions.decision: What a knowledge pack loses.
decisions.ruling: languages, lsp_servers, package_manager, lockfile and harness, from pack.yaml and from the template payload. Every other key stays.

decisions.decision: Release levels.
decisions.ruling: stackgen MAJOR, site MINOR, vwf NONE, installer NONE.

decisions.decision: A review unit.
decisions.ruling: Yes, U3 after wave 1: the plan changes runnable code (check.ts, inventory.ts, bootstrap-tools.ts) and moves serve.mjs.

decisions.decision: Execution mode.
decisions.ruling: solo: after D40 each wave holds one edit unit.

decisions.decision: Gates and keeps.
decisions.ruling: Unit: code:format. Wave: code:lint, vitest, p:plugins:check. Plan: code:precommit, vitest, tsc of scripts, p:plugins:check, inventory --check, marketplace --check, p:site:check (D28 drops claude plugin test). K1: no removed key or kind path in plugins/stackgen. K2: the snapshot matches the installed bootstrap.

decisions.ruling: Merge the tool, design-tool, pack and bundle edits and the checker into one unit, U1, which also regenerates inventory.md before it returns (the one generator a unit runs). The skills prose is U2, committed after U1.
decisions.rejected: A transitional checker that accepts both shapes, over three waves.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 5: where a tool entry's conventions.md and hooks land; which tools count as linked with no projects.
